meta_description: S.A.S Gardening is a trusted Sheffield gardener offering garden design, maintenance, and landscaping. Local, reliable, same-day quotes available.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transforms, S.A.S Gardening brings your Sheffield outdoor space to life.
services_subhead: From routine maintenance to full garden design and landscaping, we handle every aspect of garden care.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular lawn care, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal upkeep. Keep your garden looking pristine year-round with fortnightly or monthly visits.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden design tailored to your space and budget. We handle everything from patio installation to planting schemes and garden structures.

services.title: Lawn Care & Renovation
services.desc: Scarifying, aeration, reseeding, and fertilising to restore tired lawns. Perfect for spring recovery or preparing your garden for summer.

services.title: Tree & Hedge Work
services.desc: Professional pruning, crown reduction, and hedge maintenance. All work carried out safely and to industry standards.

services.title: Clearance & Tidy-Up
services.desc: Transform overgrown gardens with full clearance and waste removal. Ideal for new homes or gardens needing a fresh start.

services.title: Planting & Seasonal Bedding
services.desc: Expert plant selection and planting design for year-round colour and interest. We source quality plants and ensure proper establishment.

about_pullquote: I started S.A.S because I believe every garden tells a story worth telling well.
about_para_1: S.A.S Gardening has been transforming Sheffield gardens for over 15 years. What began as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted local service, built on honest pricing and genuine care for every project we touch. We specialise in both routine maintenance and ambitious garden redesigns.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen first and design with purpose. Whether you need weekly upkeep or a complete garden overhaul, we treat your outdoor space as an extension of your home. Hundreds of Sheffield gardens reflect our commitment to quality and attention to detail.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the garden completely overgrown when we moved in. S.A.S came round, gave us a brilliant quote same day, and completely transformed it. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished ahead of schedule. Couldn't be happier. Will definitely have them back for maintenance.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using S.A.S for fortnightly maintenance for three years now. Never missed a visit, always turn up on time, and the garden looks amazing. Not the cheapest but worth every penny. Best gardener in Sheffield, no question.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Needed urgent clearance after a bad winter. Called on the Thursday, they were here Saturday morning and cleared the whole lot. Professional, quick, fair price. Top service. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David H.
